title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 17 (DE) · „5 Gründe, Festbiss nicht zu kaufen“ – ironischer Clay-Animationsfilm
format: Stylized 3D stop-motion clay animation: a charming clay grandma at her cozy kitchen table and in a bistro, clay props (adhesive tube in bag, pocket, car, cabinet), sad talking food, clay cross-section models of a denture with gel on light blue, and the clay Festbiss tube.
